Leeku (Japanese: リーク Leeku) is a Pokémon Trainer and a minor character who appeared in White—Victini and Zekrom and Black—Victini and Reshiram.

==In the movies==
Leeku was a participant in a tournament held in Eindoak Town. He battled 's in the tournament with his . Despite nearly defeating the Fire Pig Pokémon, Leeku lost the battle when Tepig managed to defeat Samurott with a -powered , eliminating him from the tournament.
